decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (323, 323/01, 323/EX3, 323/EX2 Received 18/04/2011 and 323/02A Received 10/06/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the northern elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 5 - The ventilation system when operating at its maximum level shall be 10dB(A) below existing background noise levels and shall be mounted on anti-vibration mountings.

Condition : 6 - The extract system hereby approved shall comprise of a three-stage system to include grease,, pre-carbon and carbon filter. The duct as shown on the approved plans, shall terminate one metre above the eaves or one metre above any openable windows of adjacent premises whichever is the higher. The duct shall terminate pointing upwards. A cowl shall be omitted and lightweight flaps or other covers, which open when the system is powered, should be fitted. The system shall be routinely serviced and maintained.

Condition : 7 - The hot-food preparation associated with the use of the outbuilding shall not involve the use of more than one cooker in an area greater than 1.5m2 and the use of the outbuilding as a whole shall remain ancillary to the main use of the premises.
description: Installation of external extract duct to exisiting outbuilding and new cooker in food preperation room for boiling of meats
